title: Posting Late Fees on the Home-Site Lease Rent Ledger
content:
A late fee on the Home-Site Lease is assessed on the billing period of the most recent rent charge once that period's grace period, counted from the due date of that rent charge, has ended with its rent and occupant charges unpaid; a fee owed on an earlier period is assessed on the same terms while that period's rent charge is still the most recent one, and a late fee not assessed by the time the next rent charge falls due lapses and is no longer owed.

## Which billing period can carry a late fee

| Billing period | Grace period | Rent and occupant charges | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| the period of the most recent rent charge | ended | unpaid | assessed |
| the period of the most recent rent charge | not yet ended | — | not yet assessed |
| an earlier period, its fee not assessed before the next rent charge fell due | — | — | lapsed; no longer owed |

*Hypothetical.* The March rent charge falls due on 1 March and March's grace period ends with the rent unpaid. While the March rent charge is still the most recent rent charge on the ledger, the March late fee is assessed. If no fee has been assessed by the time the April rent charge falls due on 1 April, the March late fee lapses and is no longer owed.

## The desk tool: `post_late_fee_cfe97caa`

**Capability.** Posts a late fee on one billing period of a Home-Site Lease, dated today, tied to that period's rent charge by its ledger reference. The fee is added to the lease balance at once; afterwards it shows on the lease's rent ledger and the lease balance is higher by the fee.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_late_fee_cfe97caa` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_id` | the lease reference number of the home-site lease charged, as returned by the lease lookup | identifier |
| `billing_period` | the calendar month whose rent was late | YYYY-MM |
| `source_entry_id` | the ledger reference number of that billing period's rent charge, as listed on the lease's rent ledger | identifier |
| `amount` | the late fee charged | USD, two decimal places (cents), positive, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "posted", `entry_id` (ledger reference of the fee), `lease_id`, `billing_period` (YYYY-MM), `amount` (USD, two decimal places) and `rent_balance` (the lease balance after the fee, USD, two decimal places). The tool defines no error responses.

*Illustrative call (hypothetical values):* `billing_period` 2026-03, `source_entry_id` the ledger reference of the March rent charge, `amount` 41.25; the receipt shows the fee's `entry_id` and the balance raised by 41.25.
